ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case Record Type is ATM Dispute or Card Dispute and not in Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue or User doesn't have a Coach, Support Coach, Card Dispute Agent or FraudX Agent Role.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISCHANGED(OwnerId), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute'), AND( NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Dispute - General Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Card Dispute - Fraud Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Pending Card Dispute - General Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Pending Card Dispute - Fraud Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Support Coach Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'ID Ops Queue'), NOT(Owner:Queue.QueueName = 'Coach Queue'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Coach'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Coach Lead'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Support Coach'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'Card Dispute Agent'), NOT(Owner:User.UserRole.Name = 'FraudX Agent')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For ATM or Card cases, the Case Owner Queue must be the Card Disputes, Pending Card Disputes, ID Ops, Coach or Support Coach Queues. Or the Case Owner must have a Coach, Coach Lead, Support Coach, Card Dispute Agent or FraudX Agent Role.
